articles.summary: FLOWER MOUND, Texas , Nov. 12, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX), ("Mannatech" or "Company"), global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its third quarter of 2025. Third Quarter Results Net sales for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 were $29.2 million, as compared to $31.7 million for the same period in 2024, a decrease of $2.6 million, or 8.1%.
